In ''[[TW07|Sky]]'', more League Staff members were at [[Wyndon Stadium]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:League Staff Female Adventures.png|thumb|130px|A female League Staff in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== A male League Staff appeared in ''[[PASS05|Ooh Shiny!! Legendary Equipment]]'', welcoming [[Henry Sword|Henry]] and [[Casey Shield|Casey]] to the [[Motostoke Stadium]]. In ''[[PASS14|Teary!! The Voice of the Master]]'', a male and female League Staff apprehended [[Bede]] in [[Stow-on-Side]]. In ''[[PASS15|Shocking!! Reunion in the Forest]]'', a male and female League Staff accompanied [[Melony]], where they waited until she made her leave before calling [[Gordie]]. In ''[[PASS17|Stealth!! Infiltrate the Energy Plant]]'', multiple League Staff were seen guarding the [[Energy Plant]] entrance, where they attempted to dissuade [[Leon]] from entering. They were however blown away by [[Bede]]'s {{p|Hatenna}}. {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:LeagueStaffVividVoltage153.jpg|200px|thumb|League Staff in the TCG]] {{main|League Staff (Vivid Voltage 153)}} '''League Staff''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Amazing Volt Tackle}} and English {{TCG|Vivid Voltage}} expansions, with artwork by [[Emi Ando]].
